ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Since becoming human again, everything I eat is just so delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: С тех пор, как я снова стал человеком, все, что я ем, стало таким вкусным!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: So I want both of you to feed me with the most delicious stuff you can find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Поэтому я хочу, чтобы вы оба накормили меня самым вкусным, что только сможете найти!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Hahaha, I guess that makes sense. You can leave this to us, then!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я думаю, это имеет смысл. Тогда вы можете оставить это нам!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: We'll bring enough food to feed you ten times over!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Мы привезём столько еды, чтобы накормить вас в десять раз больше!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: As quickly as possible, please. Hehehe!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: I'm so hungry, the two of you are starting to look quite delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Я так голоден, вы двое начинаете выглядеть очень аппетитно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Uwaaah! We'll be quick, we promise, just don't eat us!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Увааа! Мы будем быстрыми, обещаем, только не ешьте нас!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta! We've got some of the most delicious food we could find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта! У нас есть одни из самых вкусных блюд, которые мы только могли найти!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: This should fill you up, Plachta! Go ahead, eat...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Это должно тебя наполнить, Плахта! Давай, ешь...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Phew, thanks. That was all very good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Уф, спасибо. Все было очень хорошо.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What! You've finished already?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что! Ты уже закончил?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I-I think I blinked and missed it! Is this what happens when you go hungry for 500 years?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Кажется, я моргнул и пропустил это! Вот что происходит, когда голодаешь 500 лет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: The 500 Years' Hunger! Yes, I might enter an eating contest under that name.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: 500-летний голод! Да, я мог бы принять участие в конкурсе еды под этим именем.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hahaha. You'll probably face Firis in the final!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Вероятно, в финале вы встретитесь с Фирис!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Probably. Anyway, recently, eating has been giving me much joy.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Вероятно. В любом случае, в последнее время еда доставляла мне много радости.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Being able to truly enjoy delicious food might be the best thing about becoming human again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Возможность по-настоящему наслаждаться вкусной едой может оказаться лучшим способом снова стать человеком.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I did eat while I was a doll, after all, but I couldn't taste the food.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: В конце концов, я ела, когда была куклой, но не могла ощутить вкус еды.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I see, I see... A bit of indulging now isn't going to hurt, then, is it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Понятно, понятно... Немного побаловаться сейчас не повредит, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hmm...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What is it, Suelle? Have I got some food stuck on my face?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что такое, Сюэль? У меня на лице застряла еда?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: No, but I was just thinking... Have you put on a little weight, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Нет, я просто подумал... Ты не поправилась, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hey, now that you mention it... You do look a little plumper!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Эй, теперь, когда ты об этом упомянул... Ты выглядишь немного полнее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Y-You might be right... I have been feeling heavier recently.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Д-возможно, ты прав... В последнее время я чувствую себя тяжелее.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I overlooked that point. Completely forgot about it! A human body gets larger, doesn't it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Я упустил из виду этот момент. Совсем забыл об этом! Человеческое тело становится больше, не так ли!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: It's much easier to put it on that it is to take it off.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Надеть его гораздо проще, чем снять.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Uwah! Is the human body so cruel?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ува! Так ли жестоко человеческое тело?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What can I do?! I want to eat, but I don't want to get fat!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что я могу сделать?! Я есть хочу, но не хочу толстеть!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sophie! Sophie! Answer me! Give me the answer!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Софи! Софи! Ответьте мне! Дай мне ответ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta... That's a battle that every human has to fight for themselves...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта... Это битва, которую каждому человеку приходится вести за себя...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: That's the truth of life, Plachta. You're living it now.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Это правда жизни, Плахта. Ты живешь этим сейчас.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sue, I think that might be going a little far!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Сью, я думаю, это зашло слишком далеко!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh... My back is killing me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ух... Моя спина меня убивает.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Eh?! Are you alright? Did you sprain it?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Э?! Ты в порядке? Ты его вывихнул?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: No way! I'm not that old yet! I just spent a bit too long at my desk last night...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ни за что! Я еще не так стар! Вчера вечером я слишком долго просидел за столом...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh... Well, maybe you just need a massage? I could help you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ох... Ну, может, тебе просто нужен массаж? Я мог бы помочь тебе.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I'm actually pretty good at it! Sometimes I even get asked by our neighbors...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: На самом деле у меня это неплохо получается! Иногда меня даже спрашивают наши соседи...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Really? Well, if you don't mind...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Действительно? Ну, если ты не против...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Sophie? Sorry, I think I'll need my usual maintenance...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Софи? Извините, думаю, мне понадобится обычное обслуживание...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ahahaha! Maintenance? You're a human now!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ахахаха! Обслуживание? Ты теперь человек!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ah... Right. Sorry, of course you're right...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ах... Верно. Извините, конечно, вы правы...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Heh... That heavenly ticklish feeling... I guess I'll never get to experience that again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Хех... Это божественное щекотливое чувство... Думаю, мне больше никогда не доведется его испытать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: She looks pretty disappointed about that. Does maintenance really feel that good?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Она выглядит очень разочарованной этим. Действительно ли обслуживание так приятно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wonder... It's not like we can do it to humans... Hm?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Интересно... Не похоже, что мы можем сделать это с людьми... Хм?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh! I've got it! Your offer of a massage. I think there's someone better to...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ой! Я понял! Ваше предложение массажа. Я думаю, есть кто-то лучше...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Aaaaahhhh...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ааааааа...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehehe, does it really feel that good, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхехе, неужели так хорошо, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It does... It really does... It feels the best...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да... Действительно так... Это лучше всего...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Wow. That's some face, Plachta! Lydie must be really good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ух ты. Вот какое лицо, Плахта! Лиди, должно быть, очень хороша.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh, I think I'm getting envious. Lydie! I want one too, after all!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ох, кажется, я начинаю завидовать. Лиди! Я ведь тоже хочу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Okaay! Just give me a few minutes here. ...Hn! This should be a good spot!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Хорошо! Просто дай мне здесь несколько минут. ...Хн! Это должно быть хорошее место!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! Amazing... you're amazing, Lydie! I can't... think anymore...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Потрясающе... ты потрясающая, Лиди! Я не могу... больше думать...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehhehe! That's right, that's right. And for the finish... there's this special technique...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхехе! Это верно, это верно. А для завершения... есть такая особая техника...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! I'm in heaven... !
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Я в раю... !

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Thank... you... very much...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Большое спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... very... good
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... очень... хорошо

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Ooops. I might have overdone it a little.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Упс. Возможно, я немного переборщил.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wouldn't say "a little"... But they look pretty happy, so I guess it's alright?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я бы не сказал "немного"... Но они выглядят довольно счастливыми, так что, думаю, всё в порядке?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Yeah, you're right! It's nice to do something good!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да, ты прав! Приятно делать что-то хорошее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Good? ... That?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Хороший? ... Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I am... very happy... Thank you...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я... очень счастлив... Спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... great
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... здорово

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... I don't think I'll ever risk getting a massage from Lydie.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Не думаю, что когда-нибудь рискну получить массаж от Лиди.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Plachta, hello.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Плахта, здравствуйте.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Girls, good timing. In fact, perfect timing!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Девочки, удачное время. На самом деле, идеальное время!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I've got a request for you. Will you watch me synthesize?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: У меня к вам просьба. Ты посмотришь, как я синтезирую?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Synthesize? But you said you couldn't do it before...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Синтезировать? Но ты сказал, что не мог сделать это раньше...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: That was because of my doll body.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Это произошло из-за моего кукольного тела.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Now I am human again, I should - in theory - be able to perform alchemy again...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Теперь я снова человек и теоретически должен снова уметь заниматься алхимией...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course! In which case, we'd love to watch you in action, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно! В таком случае, мы будем рады увидеть тебя в деле, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: We get to see 500 years of alchemy experience in action! I can't wait! Plachta, go ahead!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Мы увидим 500-летний опыт алхимии в действии! Я не могу дождаться! Плахта, вперед!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Thank you. Listen to the desires of the materials, and change their properties. Remember...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Спасибо. Прислушивайтесь к желаниям материалов и меняйте их свойства. Помнить...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I did it! Success!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я сделал это! Успех!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Great! Congratulations! Not to mention the high quality...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Большой! Поздравляем! Не говоря уже о высоком качестве...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: So this is your skill, Plachta? Uwah, I think I've got goosebumps!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Так это твое умение, Плахта? Ух, кажется, у меня мурашки по коже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe, this takes me back. The feeling of creating something new. That raw thrill!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе, это возвращает меня назад. Ощущение создания чего-то нового. Этот необузданный восторг!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been so long since I experienced this. Alchemy really is something special, isn't it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Прошло так много времени с тех пор, как я испытал это. Алхимия действительно нечто особенное, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: You're right! Alchemy is fun!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Ты прав! Алхимия – это весело!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been 500 years for you, hasn't it? That must make it feel even better!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Для тебя прошло 500 лет, не так ли? Это должно заставить его чувствовать себя еще лучше!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It does. Now I can experience this again any time I want!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Это так. Теперь я могу испытать это снова в любое время, когда захочу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I owe Sophie even more gratitude, clearly. She has given me back something very dear to me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Очевидно, я обязан Софи еще большей благодарностью. Она вернула мне что-то очень дорогое для меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe. You look so happy, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе. Ты выглядишь такой счастливой, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I'm glad, too. Please show us what you can do again soon!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я тоже рад. Пожалуйста, покажите нам, что вы можете сделать снова в ближайшее время!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course. Any time you like, girls, if that is all right with you. Thank you for today.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно. Девочки, в любое время, если вас это устраивает. Спасибо за сегодня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been a while since I synthesized anything, but there's one thing I can't ignore from this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Давненько я ничего не синтезировал, но есть одна вещь, которую я не могу игнорировать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: From the quality of this item, it's clear that my student surpassed me long ago...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: По качеству этой вещи видно, что мой ученик уже давно меня превзошёл...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I think the time may have finally come...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я думаю, что время, наконец, пришло...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie! Plachta! Do you want to play cards with us?...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи! Плахта! Хотите поиграть с нами в карты?...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Hold on. It looks like they are having some serious discussion...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Подожди. Похоже, у них серьезный разговор...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Alright, Plachta. What is it that you want to talk about?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Хорошо, Плахта. О чем ты хочешь поговорить?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Do you remember, Sophie, the goal that I once set for you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Помнишь ли ты, Софи, цель, которую я когда-то перед тобой поставил?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Of course. To surpass you as an alchemist, Plachta. What about it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Конечно. Превзойти тебя как алхимика, Плахта. Что насчет этого?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: I tried some synthesis recently. It was a success. I made an item without any trouble.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Недавно я попробовал синтезировать. Это был успех. Я сделал предмет без каких-либо проблем.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Wow, you did? That's great, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Вау, ты это сделал? Это здорово, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Thank you. However, at the same time, I realized something. You have already well surpassed me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Спасибо. Однако в то же время я кое-что понял. Вы уже значительно превзошли меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Congratulations, Sophie. You have surpassed me as an alchemist.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Поздравляю, Софи. Ты превзошёл меня как алхимик.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: As your friend, your family, and your teacher, I am so happy. You really have worked hard.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Как ваш друг, ваша семья и ваш учитель, я так счастлив. Вы действительно много работали.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...Thank you. All that work has paid off...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Спасибо. Вся эта работа окупилась...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: But this doesn't mean things are going to change, right? We'll still be a student and a teacher?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Но это не значит, что все изменится, верно? Мы все равно останемся учеником и учителем?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: No, we won't. In this moment, I think something has definitely changed.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Нет, мы не будем. В этот момент, я думаю, что-то определенно изменилось.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What do you mean?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: You've been so good to me, Sophie. You've done so much for me, all these years.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Ты была так добра ко мне, Софи. Ты так много сделал для меня за все эти годы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: I am so grateful for all of that. Too grateful for words!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Я так благодарен за все это. Слишком благодарен за слова!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: But that's also why I'm worried. Worried about you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Но именно поэтому я волнуюсь. Беспокоюсь о тебе.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie. Am I getting in your way? Are you missing out on your own happiness, because of me?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи. Я мешаю тебе? Ты лишаешь своего счастья из-за меня?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: If so, then you've done enough. You've made me as happy as I can possibly be.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Если да, то вы сделали достаточно. Ты сделал меня настолько счастливым, насколько это возможно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: For the sake of your own happiness, is it time for us to take different paths?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Не пора ли нам пойти разными путями ради собственного счастья?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: What!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Что!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: You know what I mean. Time for you to graduate. We should go our...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Если вы понимаете, о чем я. Тебе пора заканчивать учебу. Нам пора идти...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Ughhhh...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Уххх...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: S-Sophie! I'm not finished yet!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: С-Софи! Я еще не закончил!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie? Sophie! I'm only thinking of your happiness! That's why I suggested...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи? Софи! Я думаю только о твоем счастье! Именно поэтому я предложил...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Ah! She's done it now. I can see why Sophie would be angry, putting it like that...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Ах! Она сделала это сейчас. Я понимаю, почему Софи рассердится, если сформулировать это так...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Me too. Plachta is just too blunt sometimes...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Я тоже. Плахта иногда бывает слишком прямолинейной...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Oh, Sophie... What did I say wrong?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ох, Софи... Что я сказал не так?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Uwah! Plachta is super depressed!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ува! Плахта в супер депрессии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah, girls! Please help me... Sophie won't listen to a thing I say.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах, девочки! Пожалуйста, помогите мне... Софи не слушает ничего, что я говорю.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I only proposed what I did because I was thinking of Sophie's future.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я предложил то, что сделал, только потому, что думал о будущем Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah, Sophie! We need to finish our conversation...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах, Софи! Нам нужно закончить наш разговор...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Hah!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ха!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah! Aaah!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах! Ааа!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Hahaha... Sophie doesn't hold back, does she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Софи не сдерживается, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I don't understand this. I truly don't!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я этого не понимаю. Я правда нет!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Does Sophie hate me now? Is that it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Софи меня теперь ненавидит? Это все?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Come on! She could never hate you, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ну давай же! Она никогда не сможет тебя ненавидеть, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Of course not! Sophie still loves you a lot, even now!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Конечно, нет! Софи все еще очень тебя любит, даже сейчас!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's exactly why she's acting like this. Can't you see that?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Именно поэтому она так себя ведет. Разве ты не видишь этого?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I'm sorry. I just don't understand.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Мне жаль. Я просто не понимаю.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Lydie, Suelle! Please! Tell me the answer!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Лиди, Сюэль! Пожалуйста! Скажи мне ответ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I can't believe that not being able to talk to Sophie is so difficult!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Не могу поверить, что не иметь возможности поговорить с Софи — это так сложно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Uh, I'm really starting to feel sorry for her. But...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ох, мне действительно становится ее жаль. Но...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I know. We can't tell her. This is Sophie and Plachta's problem.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я знаю. Мы не можем ей сказать. Это проблема Софи и Плахты.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Plachta. You don't have to worry about anything.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Плахта. Вам не о чем беспокоиться.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's right. You just need to place your hand on your heart and think for yourself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Это верно. Вам просто нужно положить руку на сердце и подумать самостоятельно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Plachta, you're human now. The things you feel when your heart is throbbing the most...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Плахта, ты теперь человек. То, что ты чувствуешь, когда твое сердце бьется сильнее всего...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Those are your true feelings, Plachta.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Вот твои истинные чувства, Плахта.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: My true feelings?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Мои истинные чувства?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's enough hints from us! You can handle the rest yourself!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Хватит с нас подсказок! Остальное вы можете сделать сами!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: We'll see you later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: When my heart is throbbing? My true feelings? I want... for things to stay the same with Sophie!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Когда мое сердце бьется? Мои истинные чувства? Я хочу... чтобы с Софи все оставалось по-прежнему!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Luard... It's a strange thing, isn't it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Луард... Странная вещь, не правда ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yes? What?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Да? Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Sophie has surpassed me, and became a wonderful alchemist... Yet I'm so happy about it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Софи превзошла меня и стала замечательным алхимиком... Но я так этому рада!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: In the past I pushed myself so hard, not wanting to lose to anyone.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Раньше я очень старался, не желая никому проигрывать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yet now, having my student surpass me makes me the happiest I've ever been.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: И все же теперь, когда мой ученик превзошел меня, я стал самым счастливым человеком, которым я когда-либо был.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hehe. I understand that myself. Everything I've experienced changed my thinking, too.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Хе-хе. Я это понимаю сам. Все, что я испытал, изменило и мое мышление.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: It seems so clear now, doesn't it? There's no way that we two could hope to master alchemy.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Теперь это кажется таким ясным, не так ли? Мы не можем надеяться овладеть алхимией.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: With the passage of time, our alchemy will fade into the past... Progress overtakes us.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: С течением времени наша алхимия уйдет в прошлое... Прогресс настигает нас.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's good. That's the right thing. That's how alchemy evolves.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Это хорошо. Это правильно. Так развивается алхимия.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: As we become the past, more people are being saved by alchemy every day.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: По мере того, как мы уходим в прошлое, каждый день с помощью алхимии спасается все больше людей.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's why I'm happy to see us overtaken. If only I'd realized this 500 years ago...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Вот почему я рад видеть, что нас обогнали. Если бы я только понял это 500 лет назад...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Indeed. Well said.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Действительно. Хорошо сказано.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Our role now is to watch over them. To watch over and nurture the youth who will lead the future.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Наша роль сейчас – присматривать за ними. Присматривать и воспитывать молодежь, которая будет вести будущее.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yes. This will be much harder than just synthesizing stuff! Do you think you can do it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Да. Это будет намного сложнее, чем просто синтезировать вещи! Как вы думаете, вы сможете это сделать?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hah, I was about to ask you the same thing. Can a softy like you really lead people?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Ха, я собирался спросить тебя о том же. Может ли такой слабак, как ты, по-настоящему руководить людьми?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Huh! If you can do it, there's no way that I can't!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Хм! Если вы можете это сделать, то я не смогу этого сделать!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Anyway. Look at us, both back in living bodies.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: В любом случае. Посмотрите на нас, оба снова в живых телах.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Our methods differed, but we can finally collect on an idea that we forgot 500 years ago.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Наши методы различались, но мы, наконец, можем собрать воедино идею, которую забыли 500 лет назад.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's right. Something bright, shining, and so important.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Это верно. Что-то яркое, сияющее и такое важное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: The seeds of tomorrow, which can never be forgotten.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Семена завтрашнего дня, которые невозможно забыть.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hope, for the future!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Надеюсь, на будущее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hope, for the future!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Надеюсь, на будущее!
